title: Release 0.1.0: promote dev to main, tag v0.1.0, add the federated opum-marketplace entry
description: After PR #1 merges: fast-forward promote dev to main (opum-sdlc promotion), tag v0.1.0 so plugin.json matches, and add the housekeeping-skills entry to opum-ai/opum-marketplace (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json plus the Codex twin) pinned at v0.1.0 through a PR in that repository.

acceptanceCriteria.text: origin/main tree equals origin/dev tree and main is an ancestor of dev after promotion
tag v0.1.0 exists and its plugin.json declares version 0.1.0
an opum-marketplace PR adds the entry pinned at ref v0.1.0 and its federated-pin check passes

implementationNotes: Evidence: AC1 git push origin origin/dev:main (36ca7c6..6a0cfdc); tree(origin/main)==tree(origin/dev) and main ancestor of dev asserted; PR #2 recorded MERGED. AC2 annotated tag v0.1.0 (821b076 -> 6a0cfdc); plugin.json 0.1.0 at the tag; GitHub release published. AC3 opum-marketplace PR #174 (OMARK-76) pinned at v0.1.0, category workflow; pins and content checks report housekeeping-skills checked; CI runs 36327944509 and 36328020816 success. Incident: GitHub deleted dev when PR #2 was recorded merged (delete_branch_on_merge, no trunk ruleset); dev restored at the same SHA and a protect-trunk ruleset (deletion, non_fast_forward on dev/main) added; upstream finding (k).
finalSummary: 0.1.0 released: dev fast-forward promoted to main via PR #2 (asserts held), tag v0.1.0 and GitHub release, marketplace entry opum-ai/opum-marketplace#174 with green CI (runs 36327944509, 36328020816). Install works once #174 merges and opum-marketplace promotes. Trunk ruleset added after dev was auto-deleted (finding k). No checks configured on this repo yet (HS-14).
